title: Rate-limit the public /auth/* (open signup + password login)
reason: vocky exposes /auth/signup + /auth/login publicly at vocky.hi2vi.com with no server-side limiter (knowledge ships an in-process per-IP limiter; vocky does not), and a limit_req_zone is forbidden at the shared edge (global-name footgun).
trigger: At/soon after go-live: add a Cloudflare rate-limiting rule for /auth/*, or an in-process per-IP limiter in src/vocky/auth_api.py.
dropped_reason: Resolved by P12.S3, not abandoned: in-process per-(IP,route) fixed-window limiter on /auth/signup + /auth/login (src/vocky/rate_limit.py), default 20 per 900s, <=0 disables. promote-deferred was unavailable because the slice folder already existed.
